description: The bar chart illustrates Shapley values for a set of labeled categories, with three model series shown side by side for each category. The horizontal axis contains the categories in the order L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺, while the vertical axis is labeled “Shapley value” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80 with tick marks at 0, 20, 40, 60, and 80. For each category, three grouped bars appear: mBERT in light gray-blue, XLM-R in darker blue, and chLSTM in muted green, as indicated by the legend in the upper right. Approximate bar heights are: L₄⁺ shows mBERT ≈5, XLM-R ≈6, chLSTM ≈0; L₃ shows mBERT ≈1, XLM-R ≈2, chLSTM ≈0; L₂ shows mBERT ≈4, XLM-R ≈5, chLSTM ≈1; L₁ shows mBERT ≈13, XLM-R ≈14, chLSTM ≈13; T shows mBERT ≈59, XLM-R ≈55, chLSTM ≈79; R₁ shows mBERT ≈9, XLM-R ≈10, chLSTM ≈8; R₂ shows mBERT ≈2, XLM-R ≈3, chLSTM slightly below 0 (around −1); R₃ shows mBERT ≈0, XLM-R ≈1, chLSTM slightly below 0 (around −1); and R₄⁺ shows mBERT ≈4, XLM-R ≈5, chLSTM ≈0. The bars are grouped by category rather than stacked, the categories are not visually sorted by bar height, and there are no special visual emphases such as outlines or annotations beyond the legend and axis labeling.
